S_profile.meaning: accepted phase-saturation profile on the active transport coordinate

S_history.meaning: accepted recurrent/history state required by the selected transport branch
S_history.units: branch-defined; must be explicitly bound before deployment

tau_s.meaning: total-flow time of flight from streamline origin

xi.meaning: normalized path coordinate used only as an interface coordinate

rock_fluid.capillary_parameters: explicit units required by the bound Pc model

heterogeneity.layer_id: integer/category when a layered benchmark is active
heterogeneity.layer_bulk_volume_m3: m^3 when physical PV is required
heterogeneity.layer_rate_fraction: dimensionless; all active layers must sum to 1
heterogeneity.DP_coefficient: dimensionless; exact legacy definition/formula must be source-bound in V16E-0A before adapter coding
heterogeneity.F_Phi_or_Lorenz_descriptor: dimensionless dynamic heterogeneity descriptor derived from streamline flow/storage capacity
heterogeneity.SGSim_descriptors: spatial field/connectivity descriptors; never replaced by DP scalar

outputs.path_inventory: explicit mass/volume basis required by active physics

acceptance_authorities.exact_grid_mapping: conservative map-back remains final accepted state
acceptance_authorities.fallback: exact/numerical transport authority when learned proposal fails screen

role_equations.incompressible_streamline_BL: dS/dt + d f(S)/d tau = 0 under a frozen total-flow field
role_equations.layer_rate_fraction_reference: F_l = conductance_or_kh_weight_l / sum_j(conductance_or_kh_weight_j); the exact benchmark weighting must be source-bound before implementation
role_equations.local_PVI_identity: PVI_l = (F_l * q_total * t) / PV_l = F_l * (PV_total/PV_l) * PVI_total
role_equations.flux_weighted_response: response_total = sum_l F_l * response_l for flux-weighted producer response
role_equations.dynamic_Lorenz_reference: L_c = 2 * integral_0^1 F(Phi) dPhi - 1, with F/Phi construction source-bound before executable use
